direction.camera: Guide attention with desert scale; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: reduce the subject to a powerful mark inside a vast field; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with amber haze; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with sparse subject.
direction.lighting: low desert sun; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: sandstone and worn bronze; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around hard sun; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use desert scale,amber haze,monumental title,slow horizon,hard sun,sparse subject as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
